You're welcome, Safi. The 1BR in Upside Living is AED 7,000/month all-inclusive, covering VAT, water, electricity, and internet.

Rates are confirmed in 3-month blocks, so the first 3 months lock in at AED 7,000, and the following periods are confirmed ahead of time based on the season.

For a 1-year stay, that works. You'd pay the first and last month upfront plus a security deposit of AED 1,500, then monthly from there.

Want to come see the apartment first?
